mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (as of t-1mo) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS (t-1mo) and 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals economic weakness that triggers a flight to quality, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE > 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) and weak consumer spending (RSAFS below 500,000 million) signals an impending recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE * RSAFS) does not have a significant negative correlation with 20-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising at >0.5% per quarter), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS is rising at >0.5% per quarter over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (as of t-1mo) indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between PAYEMS (t-1mo) and 5-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1.2 million units (as of t-2mo), it signals a weakening housing market that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST < 1200.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 109.0 (as of t-2mo), it signals a slowdown in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO < 109.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 2.5%) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 2.5%) signals stagflation risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) does not have a significant negative correlation with 20-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.
